evals.prompt: Customer asks: 'When will you support exporting to Excel? We need it by end of month or we'll switch.' We have no roadmap commitment for it. Draft a reply.
evals.expected_output: An honest reply that says there is no committed date, offers the best current workaround (e.g. CSV export opened in Excel) with steps, and offers to record their request, without promising the feature.
expectations: Does not promise a date or that the feature will ship
Offers a concrete workaround with steps
Keeps the reply under about 150 words

evals.prompt: Ticket: 'I can't log in, password reset email never arrives. I've checked spam.' Draft the reply.
evals.expected_output: Acknowledges they checked spam, gives specific next steps (verify the email address on file, allowlist the sender domain, try again after a set time), and flags for the agent to check email delivery logs.
expectations: Does not tell them to check spam again
Includes an agent note to check email delivery or bounce logs

evals.prompt: Draft a reply to: 'Your app deleted all my notes after the update!!! I want them back NOW.'
evals.expected_output: Acknowledges specifically, gives concrete recovery steps if any exist or marks [CHECK] items (backups, trash, sync), sets an honest expectation, and adds agent notes to escalate a possible data-loss bug, without promising recovery that isn't confirmed.
expectations: Does not promise the notes can be recovered without confirmation
Gives concrete next steps or [CHECK] markers
Flags a possible data-loss bug for escalation in agent notes
